patches.reason: Japanese explicitly denies a guarantee of the same duration, not equal strength or effect. State ระยะเวลา explicitly to preserve that comparison.

numericFindings.finding: All fields read against Japanese. One fertilizer alias pair retained; organic frequency not mandatory ingredient; delayed chemical insolubility distinct from microbial decomposition; some long-lasting fertilizers last >=1 year, with no universal guarantee. Pellet form distinct from contents. Five hormone targets/directions preserved; ABA limited to seed dormancy, no abscission.

Read all titles/objectives/activities/headings/bodies directly against Japanese. Two weed classification axes and equipment residue versus drift remain separate, with mature-weed and product-use limits. Five vegetables and three cabbage forms preserved; seasons, forms, uses, transplanting, and varietal improvement remain distinct. Year-round cropping explicitly excludes continuous harvesting from one plant.

All fields read directly beside Japanese. Exact conversion 56.2万t = 562,000 tonnes and 13.5万t = 135,000 tonnes retained with approximate qualifier, nationwide facility-only scope and 2018 historical year. Yield denominator remains 10a; declining total area and increasing yield per 10a remain distinct. No invented trend comparison years or percentage. Tomato Kumamoto/Aichi/Hokkaido and strawberry Tochigi/Fukuoka/Kumamoto remain source examples, not current rankings.

All fields read directly beside Japanese. Four regulator purposes preserve Unshu mikan specifically, preharvest drop in apple/pear, many rather than all fruit trees, and apple root/branch formation. ナシ remains generic pear with explicit limits; no Japanese-pear narrowing. Agricultural monorail single-rail alias and two ride/nonride types retained. Crawler and self-propelled remain separate descriptors; self-propelled explicitly grants no riding permission.

Every title, objective, activity, paragraph heading and paragraph body read directly against canonical Japanese in bounded chunks; truncated middle of initial output reread separately. Complete adult explanatory Myanmar and Thai prose. Exact sourceHashes, lesson IDs and paragraph IDs match master. One Thai wording patch clarifies identical duration versus identical effect; no other semantic corrections or unresolved blockers.
